COMMUNITY HEALTH AND DEVELOPMENT (CHD) IS A DEPARTMENT OF SALISH KOOTENAI COLLEGE (SKC) LOCATED ON THE FLATHEAD INDIAN RESERVATION IN WESTERN MONTANA, AND HOME TO THE SALISH, KOOTENAI AND PEND D'OREILLE PEOPLE.
